Aurat ke Haq Mein

A review of Taslima Nasrin's 'Aurat ke Haq Mein' — a searing feminist work that refuses to make peace with the patriarchal structures that silence women, and asks the questions that religious fundamentalists and compliant societies alike would rather go unanswered.

By Mouli Sharma

Contributor
Mouli Sharma is a journalist, freelance illustrator, and writer from New Delhi, India. She is a published photojournalist & illustrator, having been featured in The Hindu College Gazette, & the quarterly Pink Disco.
